rows.note: Use 醫療 as the all-purpose everyday term for medical care, including treatment and access to doctors.

example.english: This clinic provides affordable health care that local residents can afford.
example.traditional: 呢間診所提供平價醫療，街坊都負擔得起。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 can2 so2 tai4 gung1 peng4 gaa3 ji1 liu4 gaai1 fong1 dou1 fu6 daam1 dak1 hei2

rows.note: Use 醫療服務 when you want to stress the healthcare services or system provided by professionals and institutions.

example.english: The government should improve health care services in public hospitals and reduce patients’ waiting time.
example.traditional: 政府要改善公立醫院嘅醫療服務，減少病人等候時間。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 jiu3 goi2 sin6 gung1 laap6 ji1 jyun2 ge3 ji1 liu4 fuk6 mou6 gaam2 siu2 beng6 jan4 dang2 hau6 si4 gaan3
